name: Lassen Volcanic National Park
tagline: Lassen — hydrothermal boardwalks and peak views when road is open.

practical.transit_note: Main park road often snow-closed late into summer.
practical.energy_note: Stay on boardwalks near thermal areas.
practical.best_start: Visitor center → hydrothermal boardwalk or lake overlook
